# The V Spot Network
> Cross-Atlantic B2B media and independent consulting on ecommerce, retail, operations, marketplaces and AI. Written and produced by Vinny O'Brien (Tralee, Ireland / New York). Satirical on the surface, analyst-grade underneath.

## Commerce Library
- [The V Spot Commerce Library](https://thevspotnews.com/commerce-library/): Question-led answers and original analysis on marketplaces, efficiency, agentic commerce, cross-border growth, retail performance and the people doing the work.
- [Should my business sell through a marketplace?](https://thevspotnews.com/vinland/everything-you-think-about-marketplaces/): Reach, economics, control and dependence in marketplace strategy.
- [What should be ready before a retailer bets on agentic commerce?](https://thevspotnews.com/vinland/the-agentic-sunrise/): How the role of software changes when the shopper sends an agent.
- [What happens when LLMs become the search bar?](https://thevspotnews.com/vinland/llms-ate-the-search-bar/): The shift from search-led product discovery to conversational interfaces.
- [Does making commerce more efficient always make it better?](https://thevspotnews.com/vinland/the-seduction-of-efficiency/): What optimisation can quietly remove from the customer and operator experience.
- [How should a retailer think about cross-border growth?](https://thevspotnews.com/vinland/international-growth-is-sexy/): The operational and commercial realities behind international expansion.
- [What do commerce numbers actually tell us?](https://thevspotnews.com/vinland/uk-retail-index-data-and-delusion/): Reading retail data in context rather than repeating the headline.
- [The V Spot's published stories](https://thevspotnews.com/vinland/): Browse the original essays and their source material by topic.

## Consulting
- [E-commerce AI & Operations Consulting](https://thevspotnews.com/consulting/): Independent advice and project leadership for e-commerce brands, retailers and commerce SaaS teams across Europe and North America.
- Focus areas: practical AI and automation; e-commerce operations; marketplace and cross-border commerce; project leadership; market analysis and operator insight for commerce SaaS.
- Approach: understand the operating problem, prioritise by value and readiness, define a measurable project, and support delivery with the client team and appropriate specialists.
- Vinny O'Brien is an independent consultant and analyst, not an AI software vendor.
- [Book a call](https://thevspotnews.com/book/): consulting, SaaS analysis, sponsorship and speaking enquiries.

## Shows
- [The Ostrich Report](https://thevspotnews.com/shows/ostrich-report/): Long-form editorial essays on ecommerce infrastructure, co-created with Hendrik Laubscher. Home of the EU de minimis series.
- [The Struggle Bus](https://thevspotnews.com/shows/struggle-bus/): Podcast. Deep operator conversations about the unglamorous middle of ecommerce.
- [Nearly News](https://thevspotnews.com/shows/nearly-news/): Weekly satirical ecommerce video news.

## Frameworks
- Friction as Currency: the argument that removing all friction from commerce destroys value.
- THOUGHT/COMMERCIAL grid: governance framework for evaluating media and consulting projects.
- Cross-Atlantic lens: reading EU commerce developments through a North American frame, and vice versa.

## VINLAND
- [The Reformation of Compute](https://thevspotnews.com/vinland/reformation-of-compute/): Part 1 of Prisoners of Compute, on open models and interpretive authority.
- [The Compute Tithe](https://thevspotnews.com/vinland/compute-tithe/): Part 2, on AI capital expenditure, debt and infrastructure cycles.
- [The Map Beneath the Cloud](https://thevspotnews.com/vinland/map-beneath-cloud/): Part 3, on the physical geography beneath AI.
- [Who Owns the Rails?](https://thevspotnews.com/vinland/who-owns-the-rails/): Part 4, on transatlantic investment, sovereignty and commerce infrastructure.
- [Arming the Rebels](https://thevspotnews.com/stories/arming-the-rebels/): A comic, personal map of commerce software, enterprise complexity and the agents arriving to inherit the rules.

## Speaking
- [Keynotes & event hosting](https://thevspotnews.com/speaking/): Essay-based talks on recognition, customer humanity, infrastructure and agentic commerce.
- [Two Million Years of Rain](https://two-million-years-of-rain.netlify.app/): Natural history and commerce; recognition over tracking.
- [Clinton’s Folly](https://clintons-folly.netlify.app/): Erie Canal engineering as a guide to building agentic commerce infrastructure.

## Editorial transparency
- [How This Was Made](https://thevspotnews.com/provenance/): The V Spot’s provenance standard for human and AI contributions, revision delta and direction count.
- [AI, data & editorial policy](https://thevspotnews.com/ai-policy/): How the network uses AI, protects information and keeps people responsible for published work.
